title: Kurara kweVakarurama
intro: Munguva iyo kutenda kwaiva nengozi uye vane simba vakaedza kuputsa kutenda, boka diki revanhu vechidiki rakaita sarudzo yaizogara ichidzokororwa kwemakore. Vachitiza zvese zvavaiziva, vakatsvaga utiziro murima rakavanzika regomo uye vakaisa chivimbo chavo chose muna Allah. Zvakazoitika zvaizova chiratidzo chisingaperi kune avo vanofungisisa.
clues: Taiva boka revechidiki vaitenda munaShe wedu, uye Iye akatiwedzera mukutungamira.
Takamira pamberi pevanhu vedu tikazivisa kuti hatizombofi takadana mumwe mwari kunze kwaAllah.
Takatsvaga pokugara mubako, tichiti, 'Ishe wedu, tipei tsitsi kubva kwamuri uye mutitungamirire zvakanaka munyaya yedu.'
Takarara kwemakore akawanda, uye zuva raizobva pabako redu risatibata.
Imbwa yedu yakanga yakarara yakarara pamusuwo webako, ichitirinda sokunge yairinda.
Patakamutswa, takashamisika kuti takanga tagara kwenguva yakareba sei, uye mumwe wedu akatumwa nemari yesirivha kunotenga chikafu.
